name: physkit
description: A framework for agentic research in experimental physics: skills, a core prompt, templates, and code for framing problems, verifying results, designing simulations, debugging, and reporting, plus closed-loop research campaigns with frozen metrics and independent verification.

interface.shortDescription: Plugin for agentic research in experimental physics
interface.longDescription: Frame, verify, simulate, debug, and report experimental-physics work, or set up and run a closed-loop research campaign with frozen metrics, reproducible records, and independent verification.
defaultPrompt: Frame a physics problem before modeling it.
Verify this result independently before I rely on it.
